configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server to be displayed publicly

configurationFields.label: Save Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server save file

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required for players to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Administratorpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for server admins. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Enable Whitelist
configurationFields.description: If enabled, only whitelisted players will be allowed to join the server. May not work

configurationFields.label: Autosave Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the server's automatic save interval. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Disable Death Notifications
configurationFields.description: If set, player deaths will not be notified in the in-game chat

configurationFields.label: Perma Death
configurationFields.description: Sets what save data is deleted when a player dies

configurationFields.label: On Death Drop
configurationFields.description: Sets what will be dropped when a player dies

options.1: Only lose backpack and weapon in hand
options.2: Lose all previous + pocket and backpack

configurationFields.label: Enable PvP
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be able to deal damage to each other (PvP)

configurationFields.label: Clear Infection On Death
configurationFields.description: If enabled, a player's infection will be cleared when the player dies and respawns

configurationFields.label: Enable Eagle Eye Purchase
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can purchase the eagle eye skill, which shows the location of other players on the map screen

configurationFields.label: Enable Air Drops
configurationFields.description: If set, air drop events will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Weapon Break
configurationFields.description: If enabled, weapons (except crowbars) will break when durability reaches 0%. Otherwise, only improvised weapons will break

configurationFields.label: Enable Sleep Mode
configurationFields.description: If enabled, time passes if all players perform the sleep emote at the same time. Otherwise, time stops

configurationFields.label: Enable Loot Respawn
configurationFields.description: If enabled, loot will respawn

configurationFields.label: Loot Respawn Timer
configurationFields.description: Sets how long loot takes to respawn, if Loot Respawn is enabled

configurationFields.label: Loot Rarity
configurationFields.description: Sets the rarity of items to be spawned

configurationFields.label: Air Drop Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of days between air drops events

configurationFields.label: Zombie Difficulty Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level for the health of zombies (zeeks)

configurationFields.label: Zombie Speed Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level for the speed of zombies

configurationFields.label: Zombie Damage Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level for damage by zombies

configurationFields.label: Hostile Human Difficulty
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level for hostile human AI

configurationFields.label: Zombie Amount Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the level of zombies spawn

configurationFields.label: Human Amount Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the level of hostile humans spawn

configurationFields.label: Zombie Dog Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the level of zombie dogs spawn

configurationFields.label: Zombie Respawn Timer
configurationFields.description: Set the time period for respawn of zombies

configurationFields.label: Human Respawn Timer
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period for respawn of humans

configurationFields.label: Animal Respawn Timer
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period for respawn of animals

configurationFields.label: Starting Season
configurationFields.description: Sets the starting season for the game

configurationFields.label: Days Per Season
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of days per season

configurationFields.label: Day Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the in-game day duration

configurationFields.label: Night Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the in-game night duration

configurationFields.label: Vitals Drain Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets the drain speed for vitals (hunger, thirst and stamina)

configurationFields.label: Enable Dog Companions
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can find dog companions to recruit

configurationFields.label: Dog Companion Number
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of dog companions that can spawn randomly

configurationFields.label: Companion Health Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the health level of dog companions

configurationFields.label: Companion Damage Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the damage level of dog companions

configurationFields.label: Building Health Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the health multiplier for player-placed buildings
